heroHeadline: Former OAS Chief Almagro Says 'Extraction' of Ortega Would Be Valid as CIDH Seeks Emergency Protection for Nine La Modelo Prisoners
heroSubtitle: Ex-Secretary General Luis Almagro told an interviewer Sept. 19 that international action removing Daniel Ortega — comparable to Venezuela's Jan. 3 removal of Nicolás Maduro — would not violate Nicaraguan sovereignty, as the Inter-American Commission on Human Rights escalated to the Inter-American Court a request for provisional measures protecting nine political prisoners held since 2014 at La Modelo. The developments came alongside a new US determination naming Nicaragua among 2027's major drug-transit countries, ICE's Sept. 16 detention of exiled ex-political prisoner Denis Palacios in Virginia, and Murillo's announcement of a fifth 2026 mass release of 1,500 common prisoners set for Sept. 21 — explicitly excluding the 46+ people still held on political grounds.
